subject: HIPAA/BAA eligibility - post-demo security follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@healthcloud.com>, security@healthcloud.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: HIPAA/BAA eligibility - post-demo security follow-up

Hi Lisa / HealthCloud team,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and a few follow-ups we promised on the call: 

- What we heard: HealthCloud is evaluating an LLM inference partner for summarization and triage workflows that will involve PHI. Primary constraints are a signed BAA and deployment isolation for PHI processing.
- Immediate asks from your side: confirmation on BAA availability, SOC 2 status/attestation, and whether Redwood can guarantee PHI processing limits to specific deployment modes.

To answer directly from Redwood's side: we do support PHI-bearing workloads under our Dedicated (reserved GPU pools with tenant isolation) and Private (VPC / on-prem) deployment modes. Hosted API (multi-tenant) can be configured with additional contractual controls and dedicated tenancy options, but by default we recommend Dedicated/Private for PHI.

Action items I have for you so we can move forward: 
1) Can you confirm which of HealthCloud's environments will send PHI (prod only vs. test)?
2) Please confirm procurement/legal contacts for BAA review so we can share a draft. I'm attaching a BAA draft and the vendor security questionnaire we use as a starting point.
3) Can you confirm desired timeline for contract review? We can turn around an initial redline in ~3 business days once we have the right contacts.

For transparency on compliance: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) attestation in 2028. I'll include the attestation link below. If you want, we can schedule a short technical session between your security team and our infra/security leads to walk through architecture and key controls (KMS, VPC peering, audit logs, data retention).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm procurement/security reviewers and preferred timeline
- HealthCloud completes the attached questionnaire and returns it to security@redwood.ai
- We set a 30-45 minute technical security sync (optional) the week of Apr 8

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: HealthCloud_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf, BAA_Draft_Redline.docx
From: Dr. Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@healthcloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@healthcloud.com, procurement@healthcloud.com
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2029 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HIPAA/BAA eligibility - post-demo security follow-up

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the materials. A few clarifications on our side: 

- HealthCloud requires a signed BAA for any vendor that will process PHI. Procurement/legal will need to review the BAA draft.
- For production PHI processing we require either Dedicated (single-tenant) or Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. Our security policy does not allow PHI to be sent to multi-tenant hosted endpoints unless there is a signed addendum and technical isolation that meets our controls.
- We will need your SOC 2 Type II attestation and any relevant control summaries (KMS, key rotation, logging/audit capability).

Procurement: procurement@healthcloud.com will own the contract review. Security: security@healthcloud.com will coordinate the questionnaire. We will aim to return the completed vendor questionnaire within 3 business days, pending internal workload.

One more thing: can you confirm whether Redwood offers customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Dedicated deployments and if audit logs include per-request metadata (caller, timestamp, model/version)? We will include those items in our checklist for the security sync.

Thanks,
Lisa
Dr. Lisa Chang
Head of Clinical Platform Integrations | HealthCloud
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@healthcloud.com>, procurement@healthcloud.com, security@healthcloud.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HIPAA/BAA eligibility - post-demo security follow-up

Thanks Lisa — great questions. Quick answers inline and next steps: 

- BAA: yes, we provide a standard BAA and are happy to negotiate. I've attached the BAA_Draft_Redline.docx for your legal team's review. Naomi (cc'd) will own the BAA process from our side and will be the day-to-day contact for redlines.
- Deployment modes for PHI: Dedicated and Private are supported for PHI processing. For Dedicated we offer reserved GPU pools with tenant isolation, network controls (private subnets, customer-controlled ingress), and optional customer-managed KMS. Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) are of course acceptable and align with strict regulatory requirements.
- Customer-managed keys: yes — Dedicated supports customer KMS integration (bring-your-own-KMS/HSM) and we can document the key lifecycle and rotation policies for your security team.
- Audit logs: our observability pipeline captures per-request metadata (request id, caller id, timestamp, model/version) and audit logs are available through the Console and can be exported for retention policies.
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) in 2028. Attestation link: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/attestations/soc2-2028-attestation.pdf

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Naomi will coordinate BAA redlines and legal contact.
2) We will fill out your vendor questionnaire and return it within ~2 business days once we have any clarifying Qs.
3) Schedule a 30-45 min security/architecture sync between your security team and our infra/security leads — proposed times: Apr 9 or Apr 10.

If procurement has a target date for contract execution, please share and we will align resources.

Appreciate it — happy to set the security sync.

Best,
Marissa
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2029 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: HIPAA/BAA eligibility - post-demo security follow-up

Marissa / Dev — quick internal note on next steps: 

- I'll pick up the BAA_Draft_Redline.docx and start a redline this afternoon; plan to have an initial pass ready by EOD Mon (Apr 8).
- Dev, can you prepare a short architecture note (1 page) that outlines Dedicated deployment controls we will present to HealthCloud (network isolation, KMS integration, audit/logging endpoints, retention defaults)? I can attach that to the questionnaire response.
- I'll also coordinate with Legal to push the redline to procurement@healthcloud.com once ready.

Let me know if anything else — I'll create a shared drive folder and drop the redline + architecture note + SOC2 attestation there and share the link with Marissa.

Thanks,
Naomi
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
